templates.title: PostgreSQL 18
templates.name: bytebalance-postgresql
templates.description: PostgreSQL relational database. Published on localhost only for Cloudflare Tunnel or local access.
templates.note: The host port is bound to 127.0.0.1 only, not all network interfaces. Choose a strong password. Docker manages the persistent volume; do not remove it when deleting or recreating the container. PostgreSQL 18 uses /var/lib/postgresql as its volume mount point.

templates.title: Redis 8
templates.name: bytebalance-redis
templates.description: In-memory data store and cache with persistence and password authentication. Localhost-only port binding.
templates.note: Use a long, unique password. The port is bound to localhost only. Docker manages the persistent volume; do not remove it when deleting or recreating the container. Redis is not a substitute for a durable database.

templates.title: Uptime Kuma
templates.name: bytebalance-uptime-kuma
templates.description: Self-hosted uptime and service monitoring dashboard.
templates.note: Open the dashboard through a Cloudflare Tunnel hostname routed to http://127.0.0.1:3001. Create an administrator account immediately and keep the application updated. Docker manages the persistent volume; do not remove it when deleting or recreating the container.

templates.title: Vaultwarden
templates.name: bytebalance-vaultwarden
templates.description: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden-compatible password manager server.

env.name: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED
env.label: Allow new registrations (disable after creating your account)

templates.note: The web port is bound to localhost only. Before first use, temporarily set SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=true, create your account, then redeploy with SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false. Put it behind HTTPS using Cloudflare Tunnel. Docker manages the persistent volume; protect it as highly sensitive data and do not remove it when deleting or recreating the container. This is an independent Vaultwarden server, not an official Bitwarden service.

templates.title: Adminer
templates.name: bytebalance-adminer
templates.note: The web port is bound to localhost only. Adminer does not include a database server; connect it to an existing database. Keep it behind Cloudflare Access or another authentication layer and do not expose it publicly.
